rec.name: PDP Gallery Review Collage Image (customer quotes + client logos)
rec.status: Designed — client-approved (final with logos); awaiting live launch confirmation

what.text: A designed square image for the product gallery that works as a social-proof slide. A headline ("Our customers are convinced") sits above a row of grayed-out client/brand logos. Below that is a stack of 2–3 customer review cards. The front card is sharp and the cards behind it are tilted and blurred. Each card shows an avatar, name (with shop or company in brackets), a bold review title, 5 green stars and a short quote. An earlier version showed an aggregate rating (4.9/5, 100+) and a heart icon. Both were removed in the final version.

why.text: Real customer voices and recognisable brand logos reduce perceived risk right where the shopper is already looking at product images. Placing the proof in the gallery means it is seen without scrolling. The sharp front card plus blurred cards behind it suggest volume and make one quote easy to read. Named reviewers with photos and a company name feel more authentic than anonymous stars. The aggregate rating was removed because no real reviews had been collected yet, which avoids a credibility-damaging claim.

how.text: 1) Design the collage in Figma or a similar tool as a square image: headline, logo row, one sharp review card in front and 2 blurred, rotated cards behind it. 2) Fill the cards with real, approved customer quotes (name, company, title, 5 stars, avatar). 3) Add a row of client or partner logos in muted gray. 4) Only show an aggregate rating (e.g. 4.9/5 and review count) if it is real and verifiable. 5) Export the image and add it as a regular media slot in the PDP gallery, usually at position 2–4. The brief was to include 1 product image with 2–3 reviews. No theme code is needed.

items: Logo row (which client logos, order, muted/grayscale styling)
Number of review cards (2–3, with 1 featured in front)
Review content per card: avatar, name + company, title, star rating, quote
Show/hide aggregate rating and review count (hide until real data exists)
Decorative accent such as the heart icon (removed in the final version)

dependencies.text: Real, approved customer reviews and avatars, plus permission to use client logos. A design tool to produce the image. A PDP gallery that accepts extra image slots, so no app is required. If the rating is shown, it needs a verified source.

items: Gallery interaction/swipe rate to the review image

images.caption: Final approved version: headline, grayed-out client logo row and a stack of 3 named review cards (front card sharp, back cards blurred). Aggregate rating removed.

Early version with placeholder reviews and the heart icon removed after client feedback.

Close-up of a single review card: avatar, name (company), bold title, 5 green stars and quote.
Inspiration reference (another brand): review cards over a photo with a 4.9/5 rating and verified-buyer badges.
